body:
Fixes #204

## Cause

The scheduled audit at `66f49e8c` found six stale entries for `lucide-react`, `cc`, and `find-msvc-tools`. Commit `3eaf9617` brought all three updates into `main` through PR #203. The subsequent push audit at `d3ef0b92` reported ESLint 10.16.0 as available. The local enforcement audit reproduced the ESLint failure in both the workbench manifest and lockfile. [Scheduled audit](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46019688128/job/140576033187) · [Push audit](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46033115131)

The root `.gitkeep` created during PR setup failed the layout test in all five initial workflows. The shared JavaScript stage stopped the Dependencies workflow before it reached the registry comparison. [Initial JavaScript failure](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46043311415/job/140656223833)

## Changes

- Update ESLint from 10.15.0 to 10.16.0 and regenerate the npm lockfile.
- Remove the root `.gitkeep` and record the investigation. [Case study](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/blob/issue-204-275f00bced2e/docs/case-studies/issue-204/README.md)

## Reproduce and verify

Run both commands from the repository root on the initial PR revision `301e298f` and the fixed revision `33539874`. The dependency audit uses live registry data.

```sh
CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_MODE=enforce node .github/scripts/check-latest-dependencies.mjs
node --test --test-name-pattern='generated evidence stay out' js/test/repositoryLayout.test.mjs
```

Both checks failed on the initial revision and passed after the fix. The enforcement audit checked 184 declared versions and all tracked Cargo lockfiles. A clean npm install, JavaScript lint and formatting, all 437 JavaScript tests, the receipt for all 41 golden fixtures, and cross-language parity passed locally.

The environment lacks `pre-commit`. The applicable checks ran manually before a standard Git commit, including the workflow policy and layout tests, JavaScript lint and formatting, the tracked-file secrets scan, JSON parsing, and staged whitespace, end-of-file, conflict marker, and size checks.

All nine GitHub Actions workflows passed on `33539874`. The hosted enforcement audit checked 184 declared versions and all tracked Cargo lockfiles. WebAssembly wrapper tests, coverage, and the React production build also passed. [PR checks](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/206/checks) · [Enforcement audit](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46043988801) · [WebAssembly workflow](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46043988703)

The Security workflow passed all five CodeQL jobs. GitHub's separate CodeQL summary is neutral because it still lists the retired C# autobuild configuration from `main`. [Security workflow](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46043988800) · [CodeQL summary](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/runs/140659104980)
title: Restore the dependency audit by updating ESLint
